# `aitbc blockchain instances`

List all chain instances on the local node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain instances [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--island` | text | — | no | Filter chains by island ID |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain instances
```
